'''Matt Sherrington Little dome droid goes bump in the night''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Matt Sherrington]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13454">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13454 Little dome droid goes bump in the night], DeckTech (Matt "MalixSolosar" Sherrington, 7 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13454/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13454/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018054452/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13454/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Matt Sherrington]]
* '''Published:''' 7 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Little dome droid goes bump in the night''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 ISB Sherrington DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is somewhat of a standard ISB Operations deck, but focuses on getting Sunsdown on your opponent's main planet and deploying spies like crazy and then using 2X-K7PR droids to boost power.

== Original post ==

'''Little dome droid goes bump in the night'''
* '''Author:''' Matt "MalixSolosar" Sherrington
* '''Published:''' February 7, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is somewhat of a standard ISB Operations deck, but focuses on getting Sunsdown on your opponent's main planet and deploying spies like crazy and then using 2X-K7PR droids to boost power.

=== Strategy ===

The strategy is rather simple.  ASAP get a scrub to a docking bay, preferably with some backup.  Then deploy Sunsdown on your Opponent's system.  If they don't have a system out, then track it or use Commander Merrejk to get it from reserve deck.  Once you have Sunsdown out, which should be pretty easy since I have two Sunsdown and two Twi'lek Advisor, I just start taking over their sites with my many characters.  The "little dome droid" (2X-K7PR) really helps, making all my characters power + 2 and Sneak Attack helps get higher destiny, since I know there isn't many high destinies in the deck.
